verdict.rationale: Paxos is a financial and stablecoin platform that handles customer and identity data, so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data is excluded from AI model training. The evidence pack never mentions an AI-training opt-out or any data-use policy. The docs' AI assistant and llms.txt files cover AI-assisted development, not training controls on user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
